newsitem.title: USA: Asia Pulp sees higher Q3 oper income vs Q2.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pulp sees higher Q3 oper income vs Q2.

text.p: Asia Pulp and Paper Co Ltd said on Wednesday it expected third quarter operating income to exceed second quarter operating income, but third quarter net income would be below second quarter levels.

The company said it expected to post operating income of $95 million to $100 million in the third quarter, compared with $73 million in the second quarter. But it expected third quarter net income to be between $30 million and $35 million, compared with $42 million in the second quarter 1996.
Sales were expected to drop five percent from the previous quarter, to between $410 million and $420 million, it said.
The sales decline was due to lower sales volume, which was partly offset by higher average realized prices, it said.
Average realized selling prices in the third quarter were about $465 per tonne for bleached hardwood kraft pulp, $1,000 per tonne for paper and $525 per tonne for packaging, it said.

Sales volume in the third quarter were hurt by increased internal pulp use for trial operations of two packaging machines, and the establishment of pulp stock in China and India for trial operations of a packaging and a paper machine there, set for the fourth quarter, the company said.

Average cost of goods sold per tonne for the third quarter decreased about five percent from the second quarter, reflecting onging efforts to improve production efficiency and reduce costs, the company said.
It said it would report full results on December 4, along with an update on all capacity expansion plans.
